visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a red-orange striped sweater and a dark brown coat, stands at a brightly lit shopping mall entrance. Behind her is a store labeled 'RAGTAG' with a large digital fashion display showing shifting model photography. She speaks directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. (2) The camera moves inside the store, showing rows of high-end clothing on metal hangers. Brand labels like MONCLER and PRADA are visible on signs. The lighting is professional and bright indoor lighting. (3) A man with bleached blonde hair wearing a grey blazer and blue jeans is seen inspecting a black leather handbag in a well-organized shelf area. Other customers are visible as blurred figures in the background environment. (4) The female narrator is shown browsing through racks of black and patterned garments. She holds up a black quilted skirt and a black bomber jacket, smiling and looking into a full-length mirror while holding the items against her body. (5) Rapid close-up shots show a furry Chanel bag in a display case, a black and white checkered skirt hanging, a beige MM6 jacket, a colorful Marni skirt, and a Celine monogrammed handbag. The setting is a clean, modern retail space with glass cabinets. (6) The scene shifts to a jewelry tray where a silver chain necklace is displayed. The woman puts the necklace around her neck, looking at the camera with a satisfied smile, touching the pendant with her hands.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An energetic female voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with a friendly, high-arousal tone, introducing the store. Background music is a mid-tempo pop track with a steady electronic beat and bright synth melodies. The indoor environment has minimal ambient floor noise. (2) The female voice continues with a fast delivery, listing several designer brands in sequence. The background music remains constant in the mix. A soft post-production 'whoosh' sound effect is heard during a visual transition between clothing racks. (3) The narration maintains high enthusiasm as the speaker describes 'finding treasures'. Subtle incidental sounds of clothing rustling are masked by the narration and music layers. The music maintain a consistent 115 BPM rhythm. (4) The voice concludes the tour with a warm, satisfied inflection. The music swells slightly in clarity during the final second before the track cuts. The overall spectral balance is bright, favoring vocal clarity and high-frequency synth elements.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Store Tour -> Brand Showcase -> Personal Purchase -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the opening of the Japanese second-hand designer store RAGTAG at Breeze Nanshan in Taipei. The video aims to attract fashion enthusiasts by showcasing the variety of high-end brands available and the excitement of finding high-quality pre-owned items.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically mentions the store location 'Breeze Nanshan' and the brand 'RAGTAG', using captions like 'opening day tour' and 'no need to go to Japan'.
